messages:
alex: Heads-up: we're seeing active exploitation attempts for CVE-2025-0421 (proto-parser RCE) in the wild. IDS flagged weird .pb uploads to our ingestion gateway.
priya: saw same alerts. Spike in 10xx failures to model-ingest between 03:20-03:30 UTC.
jamal: confirmed some pods logged stack traces referencing protocol::parseField().
alex: severity = CRITICAL, exploit is unauthenticated for certain payload shapes. Need emergency mitigation + patch plan.
priya: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) reject .pb content-type at edge 2) rate-limit upload endpoint 3) enable WAF rule for pattern. Which is fastest?
ops-dan: firewall/WAF rule is fastest. I can push a rule to block content-type+signature in next 15m.
liz: can we also toggle strict JSON-only ingestion flag? That would break some backfill jobs. Need risk call.
jamal: patch ETA: upstream fix in proto-parser landed in 3.7.2, we can vendor & build new image, but needs smoke tests. Estimate 3-4 hours to rollout to prod if we prioritize.
priya: can we do staged rollout: canary -> main -> all? Use routing policy to fallback to safe-parser for suspicious payloads.
claire: will coordinate comms. We should tell customers with Dedicated/Private that exploit exists and we have mitigations; recommend customers rotate ingest keys if they're doing .pb uploads.
sec-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-342. Triage channel: #incidents. Pager rotation: jamal (oncall), priya (sec).
ops-dan: pushing WAF block now: blocking requests with header content-type: application/x-protobuf or body pattern "\u000a\u0000\u0000\u00" (common exploit sig).
alex: good. jamal start building vendor patch. list required changes in PR description. label as emergency.
jamal: starting branch: fix/proto-rce-195876. I'll include mitigations: input length checks, safe-parse fallback, and fuzz-test harness.
priya: update audit logging: capture raw request id + matched rule so we can trace hits. Also add event to KMS audit if any key usage correlates.
liz: note — toggling JSON-only will break analytics ingestion. I'll prepare a mitigation note with expected impact and rollback steps.
ops-dan: WAF rule active — blocking ~240 requests/min to /ingest; dropping 1.2k blocked in last 5m.
claire: drafting customer notice for hosted API and partner message for Dedicated customers. Will post internal skeleton in #announcements for legal review.
release-bot: rollout queued: jamal/proto-rce-195876 -> staging at 1958765515. Auto-smoke enabled.
jamal: staging build passed smoke, pushing to canary (10% traffic).
alex: monitor canary for errors, latency, and false positives. If any parsing regressions, revert and fallback to safe-parser.
priya: also turn on token-level audit on canary for first 30 minutes.
liz: inserted quick rollback: switch ingest-route to read-only mode and drop binary uploads if we need to stop.
ops-dan: canary at 10% healthy. blocked exploit payloads dropped. No downstream downstream errors so far.
jamal: promoting to 50% then 100% in 20m if no issues. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4281
claire: customer notice queued, legal approved. Draft says: "We've deployed emergency mitigations and a patch for CVE-2025-0421; customers using binary .pb ingest should migrate to JSON or contact support."
priya: action items: (1) finish full rollout, (2) enable extra audit retention for 7 days, (3) run org-wide scan for any internal libs using vulnerable proto-parser, (4) KMS key rotation if any suspicious access seen.
alex: assign owners: jamal -> patch & rollout, ops-dan -> perimeter rules & monitoring, liz -> impact/rollbacks, priya -> audit/KMS, claire -> comms. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
sec-oncall-bot: Pager duty: incident escalated. Postmortem created: PM-2025-0421.
priya: note for audit: include the exploit payload sample (sanitized) in the incident record and tag with commit hash.
jamal: full prod rollout complete at 1958765589. No regressions observed. Closing mitigation loop.
claire: sending final customer update now.
alex: great work team. We'll keep this thread as ground truth for the postmortem.
